user_story: As a new user, I want to register with my name, email, and password so that I can create an account.

positive.title: Register with valid name, email, and password
positive.expected_result: User is successfully registered and redirected to the welcome page.

negative.title: Register with an invalid email format
negative.expected_result: User is shown an error message indicating an invalid email format.

negative.title: Register with a blank name
negative.expected_result: User is shown an error message indicating the name field is required.

negative.title: Register with an empty password
negative.expected_result: User is shown an error message indicating the password field is required.

negative.title: Register with a password that is too short
steps: Enter a password shorter than the minimum required length
negative.expected_result: User is shown an error message indicating the password does not meet the minimum length requirement.

edge.title: Register with a very long name
steps: Enter a name that is at the maximum allowed character limit
edge.expected_result: User is successfully registered or shown an error message if the name exceeds the allowed limit.

edge.title: Register with a very long email
steps: Enter an email that is at the maximum allowed character limit
edge.expected_result: User is successfully registered or shown an error message if the email exceeds the allowed limit.

edge.title: Register with a password containing special characters
steps: Enter a password containing special characters
edge.expected_result: User is successfully registered and redirected to the welcome page.
